title: Plural negative olla
focus: Form emme ole, ette ole, and eivät ole with plural subjects.

exercises.prompt: Complete “We are not at home in the morning.” Me ____ kotona aamulla.
exercises.explanation: Me uses emme ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.

optionFeedback.emme ole: Correct. Me uses emme ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.
optionFeedback.ette ole: “ette ole” does not fit this subject or construction. Me uses emme ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.
optionFeedback.eivät ole: “eivät ole” does not fit this subject or construction. Me uses emme ole: the negative verb marks the person and olla becomes ole.

sentenceExplanation.translation: We are not at home in the morning.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: subject + person-marked negative verb + ole + context

parts.role: subject: the person or people described by the sentence
parts.formation: subject pronoun; no ending is added

parts.role: negative verb: carries the person agreement
parts.formation: me takes the negative-verb form emme

parts.role: main verb after the negative verb
parts.formation: olla uses the fixed form ole after the negative verb

parts.role: context: tells the location or state
parts.formation: supplied as a complete fixed expression; no change is required

exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural negative olla: form not yet secure
